capabilities.title: List filtering over an encrypted column through the token index
capabilities.description: The `notesSearch` list parameter resolves record ids with `findEntityIdsBySearchTokens` and narrows the query-engine filter to them, instead of the `$ilike` used for the plaintext `title`. An `$ilike` over an encrypted column compares a plaintext pattern against ciphertext and returns an empty page indistinguishable from a genuine no-result. The exported `buildEncryptedSearchIdNarrowing` pins the fail-closed reading of `matched: false` — the index was not consulted, and with no fallback predicate available the filter must not widen the result.
